run_kind: SROIE receipt verification v1 — first in-distribution PUBLIC image benchmark entry (protocol self-defined on public gold, recorded for comparability)
protocol: SROIE receipt verification v1 (protocol defined here; recorded for comparability, precedent: bev-decider's self-defined 5k protocol). Pool: the OFFICIAL SROIE 400-image test pool as identifiable = the 361 test receipts with public Task-3 KIE gold (347 original + 14 recovered), taken from HF extension jsdnrs/ICDAR2019-SROIE test split; the remaining 39/400 images have no public Task-3 gold anywhere. The pinned source Voxel51/scanned_receipts (712 receipts, schema-verified: per-receipt company/date/address/total + image + OCR boxes) is trainval-side and contains ZERO official-test IDs (verified by receipt-ID join, recorded) — used only as the contamination check and sample inspection. Rows: per receipt x field (total, date, company) x {TRUE, FALSE}: TRUE quotes the gold value verbatim (outer whitespace stripped only) in the question; FALSE is a deterministic perturbation drawn from another receipt's same-field gold value (rng seeded per (receipt_id, field) under seed 2026, candidate pool excludes any value equal to this receipt's gold), exactly one TRUE + one FALSE -> 50/50 balanced. Question template: 'Does the {field} on this receipt read "{value}"? Answer No or Yes.' Options No/Yes (noul head). Eval: each receipt image encoded once (JPEG -> fp32 [0,1] -> bilinear stretch 896x896 -> frozen tower -> projector, precompute_embed.py convention), all 6 rows per receipt forwarded batched, fp32, raw softmax (no TS: gate2 temperatures are fitted on our synthetic val and documented not to transfer OOD). Metrics: accuracy (argmax), AUC of P(Yes) vs gold Yes/No, 15-bin ECE on max-prob confidence (house ece15 convention).
